MotoGP moves west for the Season Launch as Brazil beckons for the 2027 edition. Botafogo Beach in Rio de Janeiro provides an unrivalled backdrop for the flagship event, taking MotoGP into the heart of one of the world’s most iconic cities on the 21st of February.

Royal Portuguese Cabinet of Reading (Rio de Janeiro, Brazil) Constructed in 1837 by Portuguese immigrants, this Neo-Manueline masterpiece houses the largest collection of Portuguese literature outside of Portugal. Its towering, tiered wooden shelves reach dramatic vaulted glass ceilings.
